title: Revenue
summary: Revenue is part of the Accounting Standards for Private Enterprises (ASPE).
description: This standard is part of the ASPE framework issued by the Canadian Accounting Standards Board. It provides guidance on revenue.

bannerNotice.title: Revenue Recognition Retains an Older Model
bannerNotice.body: ASPE Section 3400 retains the risk-and-rewards-of-ownership framework instead of adopting the 5-step control-based model used by IFRS 15, ASC 606, and revised ASBE No. 14.
